task: Geospatial levelized-cost model for African green hydrogen to Europe via ammonia shipping and reconversion by 2030
primary_methodology: Levelized cost of hydrogen (LCOH) calculation with capital recovery factor (CRF)
Optimal PV/wind blend based on spatial potentials mapped to capacity factors
Ocean shipping cost model for liquid ammonia carriers
European green hydrogen production baseline for comparison
assumptions: Linear mapping from normalized potentials (0-1) to capacity factors
70/30 optimal blend of cheaper renewable source
Electrolyzer load factor 60% to account for intermittency
EU land cost premium 1.5x on equipment
limitations: Only 30 simulated hex sites available (not full continental coverage)
No temporal weather data - uses static potential-to-CF mapping
Simplified shipping model without port congestion or canal fees
